name: Snow Golem
description: Summons a snow golem on an empty tile within %cast_range% tile, armed with Blizzard Fist and Snow Blast. Summoning a second golem destroys the first.
details: The golem is a basic unit - it moves and attacks on its own, spending none of this unit's actions.

upgrade.summary: Raises %golems% golems at once, onto %targets% chosen tiles.
upgrade.description: Summons %golems% snow golems onto %targets% empty tiles within %cast_range% tile, each armed with Blizzard Fist and Snow Blast. Summoning again destroys whatever is still standing.
details: The golems are basic units - they move and attack on their own, spending none of this unit's actions.
The pair are a little weaker apiece than the single golem they replace.
Resummoning clears the board of every golem still standing, whether that is one or %golems%.
Unlocking this refreshes the cooldown at once, so the pair can be raised immediately.
